notes.title: Click Cricket World Cup 2024 Update
notes.notes:
Click Cricket now features all 20 countries competing in the 2024 T20 World Cup. An updated tournament format features 4 competing groups leading to a knockout phase and final.

Full update notes:-

[list]
[*]Team count increased to 20 including and now includes Namibia, Oman, Papua New Guinea, Canada and Uganda.
[*]Updated rankings based on 2024 positions.
[*]Day/Night matches now included.
[*]Current match time shown during games with teams batting later into the night facing varying conditions.
[*]Group phase now expanded to 4 groups of 5 teams (with top 2 qualifying for the knockout stages).
[*]New backgrounds for matches and tournament screens.
[*]Improvements to AI team selection including increased awareness of player form.
[*]Various small UI enhancements
[/list]

notes.title: Tournament Mode Available Now
notes.notes:
Download now to play the new Tournament Mode -
[list]
[*]16 Teams compete for ultimate cricketing glory.
[*]Group stages and knockout rounds on the way to the final.
[*]Rotate your squad to out do your opponents as well as manage injuries as you progress deeper into the tournament.
[*]Keep an eye on your players' form and fitness - but don't peak too early, save your best for the final matches!
[*]Avoid coming last in the tournament and the dreaded wooden spoon.
[/list]
As well as the new tournament mode, numerous enhancements to the game including - 
[list]
[*]Updated AI including better decision making over bowler selection.
[*]Improved menu graphics.
[*]Addition of USA to bring the total to 16 International teams.
[*]Addition of venues to fixtures with match bonuses for home teams.
[/list]

notes.title: Click Cricket Out Now!
notes.notes:
Click Cricket is a casual cricket simulation for PC and it's just been released on Steam!

Immerse yourself in the world of Click Cricket, where challenges await at every turn. Take on the AI with 15 diverse international cricket teams, each bringing its own unique strengths and weaknesses. Will you lead a cricket giant, or will you guide a smaller nation with limited resources to success?

Make choices that matter as you navigate between quick twenty over matches and the more extended 50 over format, each demanding a distinct approach. Brace yourself for the unpredictability of each game—your players' skills affect every decision, forcing you to adapt on the fly. Manage the delicate balance of a batter-heavy team compensating for a lack of bowlers or leverage a wealth of star players.

Delve into the intricacies of team management, overseeing specialized batters, bowlers, and all-rounders. Adjust the aggression of your batters, finding that delicate balance between scoring and self-preservation. Patience is a virtue as batsmen take their time to settle, but remember, overs are limited!

Strategically rotate your bowling lineup to counter the opposing batters' quick scoring off poor deliveries. Consider pitch conditions and unpredictable weather that can influence scoring ease. Deploy your star players with care; they could be the game-changer you need.

Experience the essence of cricket in its purest form, where every decision shapes the outcome. The cricket field is your canvas—no flashy marketing, just the raw excitement of the game. Are you ready to face the challenges that Click Cricket throws your way? The field beckons, and the thrill is waiting to unfold!

notes.title: Click Cricket 1 Week to Go!
notes.notes:
Click Cricket is a casual cricket simulation for PC and it's just a week to go until Steam release! A few adjustments and additions are being made over the next few days and also plenty of post-launch updates are lined up.

Updates made just this week -
[list]
[*]Team count upped to 15 now including Scotland, Nepal and Netherlands alongside the existing teams such as England, India, Australia etc.
[*]Small changes to the match engine to improve realism.
[*]International team ratings adjusted to take into account recent World Cup performance.
[*]In game help screen extended to explain some of the intricacies of the game.
[/list]

Really hope you enjoy playing!
